title: GitHub Copilot Dev Days
tagline: A hands-on developer experience where builders learn, experiment, and build with GitHub Copilot.

about.title: What is GitHub Copilot Dev Days?
about.description: GitHub Copilot Dev Days is a practical developer experience by HackUnion where students and developers learn modern AI-powered workflows, experiment with real coding use-cases, and build working outputs with peers and mentors.

experienceSteps.title: Learn
experienceSteps.description: Understand modern development workflows and GitHub Copilot through practical foundations.

experienceSteps.title: Experiment
experienceSteps.description: Explore Copilot through live demonstrations and guided activities.

experienceSteps.title: Build
experienceSteps.description: Use the tools to create real projects and solve meaningful problems.

experienceSteps.title: Collaborate
experienceSteps.description: Connect with developers, students, mentors, and the wider builder community.

communityShowcase.title: Projects and Demos
communityShowcase.description: Builders convert concepts into working prototypes, tools, and product experiments.

communityShowcase.title: Learning Outcomes
communityShowcase.description: Participants strengthen practical prompting, debugging, and delivery workflows with AI-assisted coding.

communityShowcase.title: Community Moments
communityShowcase.description: Dev Days creates peer learning loops between students, contributors, mentors, and organizers.

partnershipSection.title: Built with the Developer Ecosystem
partnershipSection.description: GitHub Copilot Dev Days is built by HackUnion with support from the broader developer ecosystem including Microsoft and GitHub. The experience remains community-led and builder-first.

finalCta.title: Build the Future with Us
finalCta.description: Join upcoming GitHub Copilot Dev Days experiences and the wider HackUnion ecosystem to keep building in public.
